sentences.text:
On The 10 th Of May, 2025
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 15938 of 2017
 Shyammani Mishra
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:
 Parties through their counsel.

Order 
The petitioner is challenging registration of the FIR pertaining to Crime No.508/2016 for the offence under Sections 450, 376(1), 323 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.

Shri Gitesh Singh Thakur, learned Government Advocate for the State informs this Court that the trial initiated vide Sessions Trial No.1/2017 is already concluded and nothing survives for adjudication in this petition.

In view of the aforesaid, this petition is disposed of as having been rendered infructuous in pursuance of order dated 20.8.2020 passed by learned Additional Sessions Judge-Sihora, District Jabalpur in Sessions Trial No.1/2017.
